# Analisis Menyeluruh Proyek F1-Tycoon (Roblox)

Dokumen ini menyajikan pemeriksaan dan analisis mendalam tentang struktur arsitektur, sistem gameplay, manajemen data, dan alur kerja client-server pada proyek **F1-Tycoon** berbasis Rojo dan Wally.

---

## 🛠️ Ringkasan Arsitektur & Teknologi

Proyek ini dibangun menggunakan standar pengembangan modern Roblox:
- **Rojo (v7.6.1)**: Sinkronisasi kode dari filesystem lokal (`src/`) ke berkas `.rbxlx` di Roblox Studio.
- **Wally**: Manajemen package Lua. Dependensi utama yang digunakan meliputi:
  - `React` & `ReactRoblox` (`jsdotlua` port): Untuk UI yang deklaratif dan dinamis.
  - `Networker` & `Bridgenet`: Penanganan komunikasi Remote Event/Function secara terstruktur.
  - `ProfileService`: Penyimpanan data aman dengan session locking untuk mencegah duplikasi/rollback data.
  - `Promise`: Penanganan operasi asinkron.

---

## 📂 Struktur Direktori Utama (`src`)

Struktur folder didefinisikan secara modular untuk membagi tanggung jawab antara Server dan Client:

```
src/
├── ReplicatedStorage/
│   ├── GameConfig.luau       <- Pusat konfigurasi (Rarity, Variant, Level Box)
│   └── EventsConfig.luau     <- Pengaturan remote event
├── ServerScriptService/
│   ├── Main.server.luau       <- Titik masuk (Bootstrap) Server
│   ├── DataManager/           <- Load/Save data dengan ProfileService
│   ├── PlotManager/           <- Manajemen klaim lahan tycoon
│   ├── SpawnerBoxManager/     <- Spawning & pertumbuhan kotak (box) exp
│   ├── BoxManager/            <- Pembukaan gacha box (reward mobil)
│   ├── ParkingAreaManager/    <- Parkir/ambil mobil di lahan plot
│   └── SellGuiServer.server   <- Server logic penjualan mobil
└── StarterPlayer/
    └── StarterPlayerScripts/
        ├── SellGui.client     <- Listener area & Toast UI penjualan
        ├── components/
        │   ├── SellGui/       <- React UI untuk penjualan mobil
        │   └── ViewportManager <- Rendering & caching model 3D di UI
        └── ...
```

---

## ⚙️ Analisis Detail Sistem Core

### 1. Player Lifecycle & Data Management ([DataManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/DataManager/DataManager.luau))
- **Mekanisme**: Ketika pemain masuk, `Main.server.luau` memanggil `DataManager.loadData()` untuk mengambil profil dari DataStore via `ProfileService`. Jika sukses, plot diklaim, data leaderstats diinisialisasi, dan data mobil serta inventori pemain dimuat ke server.
- **Live-Scanning**: Sebelum data disimpan (`saveData()`) saat keluar atau autosave, server melakukan pemindaian dinamis (live-scan) terhadap:
  1. Barang di **Backpack** & **Karakter** (termasuk status tumpukan/stacking box).
  2. Mobil yang terparkir di **AllParkingLots** di dalam plot pemain.
  3. Mesin-mesin (**Machines**) yang dibeli beserta tingkat upgrade-nya.
- **Kelebihan**: Penggunaan `ProfileService` menjamin perlindungan terhadap *item dupe* dan *data rollback* akibat server crash atau eksploitasi perpindahan server cepat.

### 2. Sistem Lahan Tycoon ([PlotManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/PlotManager/PlotManager.luau))
- **Klaim Lahan**: Menggunakan `CollectionService` dengan tag `PlotArea`. Saat player bergabung, sistem mencari plot kosong pertama di `workspace.Plots` dan memberikan tanda atribut `Owner`.
- **Teleportasi**: Pemain secara otomatis dikirim ke `SpawnLocation` di plot miliknya saat karakter respawn.
- **Pelepasan Lahan**: Ketika pemain keluar, plot dilepaskan, dan atribut `Owner` diatur kembali ke nilai kosong (`""`).

### 3. Mesin Pembuat Kotak ([SpawnerBoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/SpawnerBoxManager/SpawnerBoxManager.luau))
- **Mekanisme Spawning**: Mesin spawner dengan tag `SpawnerMachine` memicu spawn box secara asinkron. Mesin diset menjadi `IsRunning = true` untuk mencegah tumpang tindih.
- **Mekanisme Pertumbuhan (Growth Loop)**:
  - Box yang ter-spawn akan menyerap EXP secara periodik. 
  - Waktu tunggu (inter-tick) diatur berdasarkan formula peningkatan kecepatan: `2 / (1 + (speedUpgrade * 0.15))`.
  - Box akan membesar secara bertahap (stepped scaling: 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) menggunakan interpolasi `.Lerp` dari ukuran `Vector3.new(2,2,2)` ke `Vector3.new(5,5,5)` seiring bertambahnya EXP.
  - Box dapat naik tingkat hingga level 30 (berdasarkan tabel `GameConfig.BoxLevels`), yang secara visual memicu pembaruan nama model dan teks billboard di atas box.

### 4. Gacha Box & Mobil ([BoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/BoxManager/BoxManager.luau) & [CarManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ReplicatedStorage/GameConfig.luau))
- **Gacha Roll**: Pemain menggunakan `OpenBox` Remote Event. Server menghitung faktor keberuntungan (Luck) berdasarkan:
  $$\text{Luck Total} = \text{Luck Dasar Box} + \text{Upgrade Keberuntungan Pemain} + \text{Bonus Global Event}$$
- **Rarity & Weight**: Rarity mobil di-roll menggunakan algoritma berbasis bobot (weight) yang dimodifikasi oleh parameter Luck:
  $$\text{Weight Akhir} = \text{Weight Awal} \times \text{Luck}^{\frac{\text{Tier} - 1}{2.5}}$$
  *Formula pembagi $2.5$ bertindak sebagai penyeimbang agar penambahan tingkat keberuntungan tidak langsung mendominasi hasil roll secara ekstrem (anti-inflasi kasta Celestial).*
- **Variant Modifiers**: Mobil memiliki peluang mendapatkan varian kosmetik/multiplier pendapatan (seperti *Carbon*, *Shiny*, *Golden*, *Rainbow*, *Galaxy*, *Cosmic*).
- **Aplikasi Visual**: Sistem memanfaatkan `Highlight` Roblox dan manipulasi material (misal *ForceField* untuk *Cosmic*, animasi pelangi HSV untuk *Rainbow*) guna menampilkan keunikan visual pada model mobil.

### 5. Area Jual Mobil & UI React ([SellGuiServer.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/SellGuiServer.server.luau) & [SellGui.client.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/SellGui.client.luau))
- **UI Berbasis React**: Ketika pemain berdiri dekat dengan `SellArea` plot mereka (jarak $\le 8$ studs), client mendeteksi proximity ini dan memasang (mount) UI penjualan secara dinamis ke layar.
- **Keamanan Penjualan (Anti-Cheat)**:
  - Client hanya mengirim data instansi Tool mobil yang ingin dijual.
  - Server melakukan verifikasi jarak antara pemain dan `SellArea` di sisi server sebelum memberikan Cash. Jika jarak $> 8$ studs, transaksi ditolak. Hal ini mencegah eksploitasi teleport/teleport-selling ilegal oleh pengeksploitasi (exploiter).

---

## 🔍 Temuan Masalah & Rekomendasi Peningkatan

Berikut adalah area yang dapat ditingkatkan demi performa, pengalaman pengguna, dan keamanan game:

### 1. Pembersihan Objek Lahan saat Pemain Keluar (Plot Cleanups)
- 🔴 **Temuan**: Saat pemain keluar, `PlotManager.releasePlot()` hanya mengubah atribut `Owner` plot menjadi `""` dan mereset papan billboard. Namun, mobil yang terparkir (`AllParkingLots`) dan kotak yang sedang tumbuh di mesin (`SpawnerMachine`) tidak secara eksplisit dihapus dari workspace server.
- 💡 **Rekomendasi**: Tambahkan fungsi pembersihan di `PlotManager.releasePlot()` untuk menghancurkan (`:Destroy()`) seluruh model mobil dan kotak yang tersisa di plot tersebut untuk menghindari kebocoran memori (memory leak) di server seiring waktu.

### 2. Batas Kapasitas Inventori yang Ter-Hardcode
- 🔴 **Temuan**: Batas slot maksimum inventori sebanyak 50 slot didefinisikan secara statis (hardcoded) di `BoxManager.luau` (`local maxInventorySlots = 50`).
- 💡 **Rekomendasi**: Pindahkan konfigurasi ini ke `GameConfig.luau` agar tersentralisasi, atau integrasikan dengan sistem peningkatan (upgrade) kapasitas tas pemain di kemudian hari.

### 3. Sinkronisasi Penulisan Kasus Remote Event / Method (Networker)
- 🔴 **Temuan**: Pada `BoxManager.luau`, registrasi fungsi server adalah:
  ```lua
  Networker.server.new("OpenBox", BoxManager, {
      BoxManager.printTest,
      BoxManager.openBox,
  })
  ```
  Tetapi pada `OpenBoxGui.client.luau`, client memanggil dengan huruf kecil:
  ```lua
  local result = networker:fetch("openBox", selectedBox)
  ```
  Jika terjadi ketidakcocokan casing pada mapping internal library `Networker`, hal ini berpotensi memicu kegagalan pemanggilan fungsi.
- 💡 **Rekomendasi**: Pastikan penulisan casing method selalu konsisten antara server dan client (misal, semua menggunakan PascalCase seperti `OpenBox` / `OpenBox` atau CamelCase).

### 4. Optimalisasi Cache Viewport UI
- 🟢 **Apresiasi**: Implementasi `ViewportManager.luau` dengan batasan `MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 10` dan pelepasan parent secara eksplisit saat pembersihan cache sangat baik dalam menjaga penggunaan RAM client dari kebocoran tekstur 3D di UI.

---

## 📈 Alur Siklus Hidup Transaksi (Gacha & Jual)

Berikut visualisasi alur siklus hidup mobil dari perolehan box hingga penjualan:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Player as Pemain
    participant Client as Client (UI / Tool)
    participant Server as Server (Manager)
    participant DB as DataStore (ProfileService)

    Player->>Client: Dekati Spawner & Ambil Box
    Server->>Server: Hitung EXP Box & Naikkan Level/Size
    Player->>Client: Klik "Open Box" (Equipped)
    Client->>Server: Remote: openBox(boxName)
    Note over Server: Validasi Jarak & Kepemilikan Box
    Server->>Server: Hitung Total Luck & Roll Mobil
    Server->>Client: Berikan Mobil ke Backpack
    Player->>Client: Dekati Area Sell (Jarak <= 8 studs)
    Client->>Client: Mount UI React (SellGui)
    Player->>Client: Klik "Sell" / "Sell All"
    Client->>Server: Remote: sellCar / sellAllCars
    Note over Server: Server Verifikasi Jarak Pemain ke Sell Area
    Server->>Server: Tambah Cash & Hancurkan Mobil
    Server->>Client: Konfirmasi Sukses (Tampilkan Toast)
    Player->>DB: Keluar Server -> Autosave Plot & Inventori
```

function PlotManager.releasePlot(player)
	local plotName = player:GetAttribute("MyPlotName")
	if plotName then
		local plot = workspace.Plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
		if plot then
			-- 1. Reset Owner Plot
			plot:SetAttribute("Owner", "")
			local label = plot:FindFirstChild("TextLabel", true)
			if label then
				label.Text = "Plot Kosong"
			end

			-- 2. Bersihkan Mobil di Lahan Parkir (AllParkingLots)
			local parkingLots = plot:FindFirstChild("AllParkingLots")
			if parkingLots then
				for _, parking in pairs(parkingLots:GetChildren()) do
					local carsFolder = parking:FindFirstChild("MyCars", true)
					if carsFolder then
						for _, car in pairs(carsFolder:GetChildren()) do
							pcall(function()
								car:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end

					-- Reset ProximityPrompt status di area parkir
					local prompt = parking:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") or parking:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt", true)
					if prompt then
						prompt:SetAttribute("IsActive", false)
					end
				end
			end

			-- 3. Bersihkan Box & Reset Atribut Mesin (Machines)
			local plotMachines = plot:FindFirstChild("Machines")
			if plotMachines then
				for _, machineArea in pairs(plotMachines:GetChildren()) do
					-- Nonaktifkan mesin spawner
					machineArea:SetAttribute("Active", false)
					machineArea:SetAttribute("IsRunning", false)

					-- Cari part fisik mesin
					local machinePart = nil
					for _, child in pairs(machineArea:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(child.Name, "Machine") then
							machinePart = child
							break
						end
					end

					if not machinePart then
						machinePart = machineArea:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
					end

					if machinePart then
						-- Hancurkan box-box yang tersisa di dalam mesin
						for _, child in pairs(machinePart:GetChildren()) do
							-- Hancurkan objek bertag Box atau Tool/Model
							if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Box") then
								pcall(function()
									child:Destroy()
								end)
							end
						end

						-- Reset semua upgrade atribut pada part mesin kembali ke nil
						for name, _ in pairs(machinePart:GetAttributes()) do
							pcall(function()
								machinePart:SetAttribute(name, nil)
							end)
						end
					end

					-- Reset semua atribut kustom pada folder machineArea sendiri
					for name, _ in pairs(machineArea:GetAttributes()) do
						if name ~= "IsInitialized" then -- Pertahankan inisialisasi awal
							pcall(function()
								machineArea:SetAttribute(name, nil)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

I've made a breakthrough. I realized the loading path for `ActiveBox` already existed in `SpawnerBoxManager.luau`, using `machineData.ActiveBox`! However, the saving path in `DataManager.luau` was entirely absent. It's an incomplete feature; the load logic was there, but save logic was forgotten. Addressing this missing save logic will make growing box progress permanent across sessions, which is a big win. I'll add the missing code, or implement more sophisticated ideas if possible.

# Usulan Perbaikan & Peningkatan Kritis F1-Tycoon

Berdasarkan analisis mendalam terhadap kode runtime dan data flow, saya menemukan beberapa **bug kritis** dan **celah fitur (feature gap)** yang perlu segera diperbaiki. Berikut rinciannya beserta usulan solusinya:

---

## 🚨 1. Bug Gacha Cache Kritis (Membatalkan Randomness Spawner)
- **Lokasi**: [SpawnerBoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/SpawnerBoxManager/SpawnerBoxManager.luau#L91-L116)
- **Masalah**:
  Sistem mencoba mengoptimalkan pemrosesan varian dengan melakukan *caching* hasil kalkulasi acak (`variantCache`).
  ```lua
  local cacheKey = playerUpgrade .. "_" .. globalVariantBoost
  if variantCache[cacheKey] then
      activeVariants = variantCache[cacheKey]
  else
      -- Melakukan roll acak dengan math.random()
      ...
      variantCache[cacheKey] = activeVariants
  end
  ```
  Karena yang disimpan ke dalam cache adalah **hasil akhir dari roll acak**, maka setelah spawner melakukan roll pertama kali untuk suatu kombinasi upgrade (misalnya `0_0`), hasil tersebut terkunci.
  - Jika roll pertama menghasilkan **"Normal"**, maka **selamanya** box yang di-spawn untuk pemain dengan upgrade tersebut akan bertipe **"Normal"** (tidak akan pernah muncul *Golden*, *Galaxy*, dll.).
  - Sebaliknya, jika beruntung mendapatkan **"Galaxy"** di awal, maka **semua** box yang muncul akan selalu bertipe **"Galaxy"**.
- **Solusi**:
  Kalkulasi varian sangatlah ringan (kurang dari 1 mikrodetik untuk tabel berisi 9 varian). **Hapus total sistem `variantCache`** ini dan biarkan server melakukan roll acak secara murni setiap kali box baru di-spawn.

---

## 💾 2. Hilangnya Progress Box saat Keluar Game (Save Path Terputus)
- **Lokasi**: [DataManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/DataManager/DataManager.luau#L75-L98) & [SpawnerBoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/SpawnerBoxManager/SpawnerBoxManager.luau#L366-L370)
- **Masalah**:
  Pada `SpawnerBoxManager.luau`, terdapat logika untuk **memuat** kembali kotak aktif jika data tersebut ada (`machineData.ActiveBox`):
  ```lua
  if machineData and machineData.ActiveBox then
      spawnBox(player, machineArea, machineData.ActiveBox)
  ```
  Namun, pada `DataManager.luau` di fungsi `extractMachineData`, data kotak aktif ini **tidak pernah disimpan**!
  ```lua
  local mData = {
      Name = machineArea.Name,
      Attributes = extractAttributes(machineArea),
      PartAttributes = extractAttributes(machinePart),
      -- 'ActiveBox' tidak ada di sini!
  }
  ```
  Akibatnya, jika pemain keluar game saat kotak mereka sedang berkembang di atas mesin (misalnya sudah Level 20 dengan ribuan EXP), progress kotak tersebut akan **hilang sepenuhnya** dan kembali ke Level 1 saat login kembali.
- **Solusi**:
  Perbarui `DataManager.extractMachineData` agar memindai apakah ada objek kotak (Tool bertag/beratribut `Level`) di dalam `machinePart`, mengambil statusnya (`Level`, `Exp`, `Variants`), dan memasukkannya ke dalam tabel penyimpanan `ActiveBox`.

---

## ⚡ 3. Batas Aman Waktu Tunggu Spawner (*Wait Cap*)
- **Lokasi**: [SpawnerBoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/SpawnerBoxManager/SpawnerBoxManager.luau#L170)
- **Masalah**:
  Sistem melakukan jeda pertumbuhan box dengan formula:
  ```lua
  task.wait(2 / (1 + (speed * 0.15)))
  ```
  Jika terjadi eksploitasi nilai `speed` (upgrade sangat tinggi atau manipulasi memori), nilai pembagi bisa sangat besar sehingga jeda waktu mendekati `0` (atau bernilai negatif jika `speed` bernilai minus). Hal ini bisa membanjiri antrean server (*server crash/lag*).
- **Solusi**:
  Beri batas aman minimum (*wait cap*) waktu tunggu sebesar `0.1` detik menggunakan `math.max()`:
  ```lua
  task.wait(math.max(0.1, 2 / (1 + (speed * 0.15))))
  ```

---

## 📁 4. Pemindahan Konfigurasi Kapasitas Tas (*Hardcoded Config*)
- **Lokasi**: [BoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/BoxManager/BoxManager.luau#L202)
- **Masalah**:
  Variabel `maxInventorySlots = 50` saat ini dideklarasikan langsung di dalam fungsi pembukaan box di server script.
- **Solusi**:
  Pindahkan variabel ini ke **[GameConfig.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ReplicatedStorage/GameConfig.luau)** agar jika ada perubahan limitasi (atau integrasi dengan upgrade slot tas di masa depan), modifikasinya terpusat di satu berkas konfigurasi saja.

args.Description: Add ActiveBox saving path in DataManager.extractMachineData to preserve the level, experience, and variants of growing boxes across sessions.
args.Instruction: Update extractMachineData to scan for tools representing active boxes under the machine part, extracting their attributes to serialize into the returned table as ActiveBox.
args.ReplacementContent:
function DataManager.extractMachineData(player, machineArea: Instance)
	if not machineArea then
		return nil
	end

	local machinePart = nil
	for _, child in pairs(machineArea:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(child.Name, "Machine") then
			machinePart = child
			break
		end
	end

	if not machinePart then
		machinePart = machineArea:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
	end

	-- Scan for any active box currently growing on this machine part
	local activeBoxData = nil
	if machinePart then
		for _, child in pairs(machinePart:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") and child:GetAttribute("Level") ~= nil then
				activeBoxData = {
					Level = child:GetAttribute("Level") or 1,
					Exp = child:GetAttribute("Exp") or 0,
					Variants = child:GetAttribute("Variants") or "Normal",
				}
				break
			end
		end

function DataManager.extractMachineData(player, machineArea: Instance)
	if not machineArea then
		return nil
	end

	local machinePart = nil
	for _, child in pairs(machineArea:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(child.Name, "Machine") then
			machinePart = child
			break
		end
	end

	if not machinePart then
		machinePart = machineArea:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
	end

	local mData = {
		Name = machineArea.Name,
		Attributes = extractAttributes(machineArea),
		PartAttributes = extractAttributes(machinePart),
	}
	return mData
end

Kedua masalah tersebut disebabkan oleh **dua kesalahan fatal** berikut yang kini telah saya perbaiki:

### 🛠️ Detail Perbaikan & Optimasi:

1. **Mengatasi Lag Ekstrem & Loop Rendering Tak Terbatas**:
   - **Masalah**: Kedua fungsi `useEffect` pada baris 148 dan 199 sebelumnya **tidak memiliki array dependensi** (dependency array). Dalam React, hal ini menyebabkan efek tersebut berjalan pada *setiap render*. Karena di dalam efek pertama terdapat panggilan `setCars(backpackCars)` yang mengubah state, React memicu re-render ulang secara terus-menerus (infinite render loop). Ini membebani RAM/CPU client dan membuat UI terasa sangat berat.
   - **Solusi**: 
     - Menambahkan array dependensi kosong (`{}`) pada `useEffect` pendengar data backpack agar efek ini hanya didaftarkan **sekali saja saat UI pertama kali terbuka (mount)**.
     - Menambahkan array dependensi berisi `{ cars }` pada `useEffect` pembuatan viewport agar proses pemuatan model 3D hanya dipicu saat daftar mobil di tas mengalami perubahan nyata.

2. **Mengapa Data Mobil Tidak Muncul**:
   - **Masalah 1 (Nested ScreenGui)**: Komponen `SellGui` di game asli mengembalikan elemen `ScreenGui` baru bernama `"SellGui"`. Padahal, pada **[SellGui.client.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/SellGui.client.luau)**, ia sudah di-mount ke dalam `ScreenGui` yang dibuat secara terprogram. Hal ini menghasilkan penumpukan elemen (`ScreenGui` di dalam `ScreenGui`), yang merusak struktur rendering Roblox dan membuat fungsi `FindFirstDescendant` gagal mendeteksi letak komponen `CarView_i` karena instansi Gui yang bertabrakan.
   - **Masalah 2 (Inkonsistensi Casing Storybook)**: Papan UI Storybook mengirimkan properti `IsStorybook` (huruf kapital), sedangkan komponen membacanya sebagai `isStorybook` (huruf kecil). Hal ini membuat komponen berpikir ia berada di game asli dan membungkus dirinya lagi dengan ScreenGui tambahan.
   - **Solusi**:

useEffect(function()
		local activeBackpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5) or player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		if not activeBackpack then
			warn("[SellGui] Backpack tidak ditemukan!")
			return
		end

		if isStorybook then
			setCars({
				{ Name = "Ferrari F1 2024", Price = 50000, Variant = "Golden", Rarity = "Legendary", Amount = 1 },
				{ Name = "Mercedes AMG GT", Price = 45000, Variant = "Normal", Rarity = "Epic", Amount = 2 },
				{ Name = "Lamborghini Revuelto", Price = 35000, Variant = "Galaxy", Rarity = "Rare", Amount = 1 },
				{ Name = "Porsche 911 Turbo", Price = 40000, Variant = "Normal", Rarity = "Epic", Amount = 1 },
			})
			return
		end

		local function updateCars()
			local backpackCars = {}
			local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

			-- 1. Pindai item di Backpack
			for _, tool in pairs(activeBackpack:GetChildren()) do
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					local isCar = CollectionService:HasTag(tool, "Car") or tool:GetAttribute("Price") ~= nil
					if isCar then
						table.insert(backpackCars, tool)
						print("[SellGui] Menemukan mobil di Backpack: " .. tool.Name .. " - Price: " .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("Price")))
					end
				end
			end

			-- 2. Pindai item di Karakter (Mobil yang sedang di-equip)
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				for _, tool in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
					if tool:IsA("Tool") then
						local isCar = CollectionService:HasTag(tool, "Car") or tool:GetAttribute("Price") ~= nil
						if isCar then
							if not table.find(backpackCars, tool) then
								table.insert(backpackCars, tool)
								print("[SellGui] Menemukan mobil di Karakter (Equipped): " .. tool.Name .. " - Price: " .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("Price")))
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			print("[SellGui] Total mobil berhasil dimuat ke UI: " .. tostring(#backpackCars))
			setCars(backpackCars)
		end

		-- Pindai awal
		updateCars()

		-- Hubungkan listener perubahan backpack
		local connection = activeBackpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.3, updateCars)
		end)

		local removeConnection = activeBackpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.1, updateCars)
		end)

		-- Hubungkan listener ketika karakter berpindah/meng-equip sesuatu
		local charAddedConn
		local charChildAddedConn
		local charChildRemovedConn

		local function setupCharacterListeners(character)
			if charChildAddedConn then charChildAddedConn:Disconnect() end
			if charChildRemovedConn then charChildRemovedConn:Disconnect() end

			charChildAddedConn = character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					task.delay(0.1, updateCars)
				end
			end)
			charChildRemovedConn = character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					task.delay(0.1, updateCars)
				end
			end)
		end

		if player.Character then
			setupCharacterListeners(player.Character)
		end

		charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			setupCharacterListeners(character)
			task.delay(0.5, updateCars)
		end)

		return function()
			connection:Disconnect()
			removeConnection:Disconnect()
			if charAddedConn then charAddedConn:Disconnect() end
			if charChildAddedConn then charChildAddedConn:Disconnect() end
			if charChildRemovedConn then charChildRemovedConn:Disconnect() end
		end
	end, {})

Saya telah memperbarui berkas **[SellGui.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/components/SellGui/SellGui.luau)** untuk menyelesaikan masalah data mobil yang tidak muncul secara total.

### 🔍 Analisis Penyebab Masalah Baru:
Masalah ini ternyata disebabkan oleh **Stale Instance Reference (Referensi Instansi yang Basi)** pada daur hidup (*lifecycle*) Roblox:
1. **Referensi Backpack yang Basi**: Variabel `backpack` sebelumnya dideklarasikan sekali saja di tingkat modul (`local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")`). Di Roblox, setiap kali karakter pemain mati/respawn (atau di-inisialisasi pertama kali di game), objek `Backpack` yang lama akan dihancurkan dan **digantikan dengan objek Backpack yang baru**. Karena kode UI mengunci referensi ke Backpack yang lama (yang sudah hancur), list `:GetChildren()` selalu kosong dan event `.ChildAdded` tidak pernah terpicu.
2. **Mobil yang Sedang Dipegang (Equipped)**: Saat pemain melengkapi/memegang mobil (*equip tool*), instansi Tool berpindah dari `Backpack` ke dalam model `Character` di workspace. Logika sebelumnya hanya membaca dari `Backpack`, sehingga mobil yang sedang dipegang di tangan pemain tidak akan muncul di UI penjualan.

---

### 🛠️ Solusi & Perbaikan yang Diterapkan:

1. **Pengambilan Backpack Dinamis**:
   Saya menghapus cache tingkat modul dan memindahkan pengambilan Backpack secara dinamis ke dalam `useEffect` saat UI di-*mount* (`local activeBackpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")`). Ini menjamin UI selalu membaca instansi Backpack yang aktif saat itu.
   
2. **Pemindaian Ganda (Backpack & Character)**:
   Fungsi pembacaan data kini memindai dua area:
   - **Backpack** pemain untuk mobil yang disimpan.
   - **Character** pemain untuk mendeteksi jika ada mobil yang sedang di-equip (dipegang di tangan).
   - Menambahkan event listener `ChildAdded` & `ChildRemoved` pada **Character** untuk langsung memperbarui daftar mobil di UI jika pemain meng-equip atau men-unequip mobil secara *real-time*.

3. **Kombinasi Filter Deteksi yang Kuat**:
   Mobil sekarang terdeteksi jika memenuhi salah satu syarat:
   - Memiliki tag CollectionService bernama `"Car"` (dari sistem `CarManager`).
   - Atau memiliki atribut `"Price"` (termasuk jika Anda menghapus batasan atribut tersebut).

4. **Pencetakan Log Debug (Output Console)**:

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local React = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.React)
local ViewportManager = require(script.Parent.Parent.ViewportManager)

local e = React.createElement
local useState = React.useState
local useEffect = React.useEffect

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ===== UTILITIES =====
local viewportCache = ViewportManager.new()

local function formatPrice(price)
	return ViewportManager.formatPrice(price)
end

-- ===== NESTED SUB-CAR ITEM COMPONENT (FOR STACK MEMBERS) =====
local function SubCarItem(props)
	local car = props.car
	local stackChildName = props.stackChildName
	local onSell = props.onSell
	
	local carName = props.name or "Unknown"
	local carPrice = props.price or 0
	local carVariant = props.variant or "Normal"
	local carRarity = props.rarity or "Common"
	local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
	local rarityColor = GameConfig.Rarities[carRarity] and GameConfig.Rarities[carRarity].Color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)

	return e("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 75), -- Indented from left by 30 pixels
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40),
		BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65),
		BorderSizePixel = 1,
		LayoutOrder = props.layoutOrder or 1,
	}, {
		UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		
		-- Small indicator line on the left showing rarity color
		RarityBar = e("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -12),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
			BackgroundColor3 = rarityColor,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, {
			UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) }),

		}, {
			UIListLayout = e("UIListLayout", {

				Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),

			}),

			MetaText = e("TextLabel", {

				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),

		ActionArea = e("Frame", {

end

-- ===== CAR ITEM COMPONENT =====
local function CarItem(props)
	local car = props.car
	local onSell = props.onSell
	local isExpanded = props.isExpanded
	local onToggleExpand = props.onToggleExpand

	local carName = "Unknown"
	local carPrice = 0
	local carVariant = "Normal"
	local carAmount = 1
	local carRarity = "Common"
	local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))

	if typeof(car) == "Instance" and car:IsA("Tool") then
		carName = car:GetAttribute("Name") or car.Name
		carPrice = car:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
		carVariant = car:GetAttribute("Variant") or "Normal"
		carAmount = car:GetAttribute("Amount") or 1
		carRarity = car:GetAttribute("Rarity") or "Common"
	elseif type(car) == "table" then
		carName = car.Name or "Unknown"
		carPrice = car.Price or 0
		carVariant = car.Variant or "Normal"
		carAmount = car.Amount or 1
		carRarity = car.Rarity or "Common"
	end

	local isStack = carAmount > 1
	local rarityColor = GameConfig.Rarities[carRarity] and GameConfig.Rarities[carRarity].Color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)

	-- Build nested sub-items UI if it is a stack and expanded
	local subItems = {}
	if isStack and isExpanded then
		-- 1. Main Base Tool (Representing the first car item)
		table.insert(subItems, e(SubCarItem, {
			car = car,
			stackChildName = "Base",
			name = carName,
			price = carPrice,
			variant = carVariant,
			rarity = carRarity,
			onSell = onSell,
			layoutOrder = 1,
		}))

		-- 2. Inner stack configurations in tool folder
		if typeof(car) == "Instance" then
			local stacksFolder = car:FindFirstChild("Stacks")
			if stacksFolder then
				local index = 2
				for _, configNode in ipairs(stacksFolder:GetChildren()) do
					if configNode:IsA("Configuration") then
						table.insert(subItems, e(SubCarItem, {
							car = car,
							stackChildName = configNode.Name,
							name = carName,
							price = configNode:GetAttribute("Price") or 0,
							variant = configNode:GetAttribute("Variant") or "Normal",
							rarity = configNode:GetAttribute("Rarity") or "Common",
							onSell = onSell,
							layoutOrder = index,
						}))
						index = index + 1
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- Mock stack children for UI Storybook
			for i = 2, carAmount do
				table.insert(subItems, e(SubCarItem, {
					car = car,
					stackChildName = "MockStack_" .. i,
					name = carName,
					price = carPrice,
					variant = carVariant,
					rarity = carRarity,
					onSell = onSell,
					layoutOrder = i,
				}))
			end
		end
	end

	local subItemsContainer = nil
	if #subItems > 0 then
		local layout = {
			UIListLayout = e("UIListLayout", {
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}),
		}
		for i, child in ipairs(subItems) do
			layout["SubCar_" .. i] = child
		end

		subItemsContainer = e("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = 2,
		}, layout)
	end

	return e("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = props.layoutOrder or 1,
	}, {
		UIListLayout = e("UIListLayout", {
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		}),

		-- Card Head (Main Info Box)
		CardHeader = e("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 110),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30),
			BorderColor3 = isStack and Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60),
			BorderSizePixel = isStack and 1.5 or 1,
			LayoutOrder = 1,
		}, {
			UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),

			-- Glowing outline visual indicator if it is a stack
			GlowLine = isStack and e("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -16),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 8),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, {
				UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) }),
			}) or nil,

			ViewportFrame = e("ViewportFrame", {
				Name = "CarView_" .. (props.layoutOrder or 1),
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 90),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 10),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, {
				UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
				AmountLabel = e("TextLabel", {
					Text = "x" .. tostring(carAmount),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 22),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -17.5, 1, -25),
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					BackgroundColor3 = isStack and Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
					BorderColor3 = isStack and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80),
					BorderSizePixel = 1,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				}, {
					UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }),
				}),
			}),

			-- Click target to expand (only active if it is a stack)
			ExpandClickButton = isStack and e("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "",
				[React.Event.Activated] = onToggleExpand,
			}) or nil,

			InfoContainer = e("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, isStack and -240 or -230, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, {
				NameLabel = e("TextLabel", {
					Text = string.sub(carName, 1, 24),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 12),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				}),

				RarityBadge = e("TextLabel", {
					Text = carRarity:upper(),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 18),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40),
					BackgroundColor3 = rarityColor,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				}, {
					UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }),
				}),

				VariantLabel = e("TextLabel", {
					Text = carVariant,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 18),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 40),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				}),

				PriceLabel = e("TextLabel", {
					Text = isStack and "MULTIPLE CARS STACKED" or ("$" .. formatPrice(carPrice)),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -30),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					TextColor3 = isStack and Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(90, 240, 90),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				}),
			}),

			ActionArea = e("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			}, {
				-- Show SELL button if it is a single car
				SellButton = not isStack and e("TextButton", {
					Text = "SELL",
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -22),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 45, 45),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					[React.Event.Activated] = function()
						if onSell then
							onSell(car)
						end
					end,
				}, {
					UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
				}) or nil,

				-- Show EXPAND/COLLAPSE toggle button if it is a stack
				ExpandButton = isStack and e("TextButton", {
					Text = isExpanded and "COLLAPSE" or "VIEW STACK",
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -22),
					BackgroundColor3 = isExpanded and Color3.fromRGB(50, 60, 75) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 110, 180),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					[React.Event.Activated] = onToggleExpand,
				}, {
					UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
				}) or nil,
			}),
		}),

		-- Sub items list below
		SubItemsList = subItemsContainer,
	})
end

-- ===== MAIN SELLGUI COMPONENT =====
local function SellGui(props)
	local isStorybook = props.isStorybook or props.IsStorybook or false
	local cars, setCars = useState({})
	local expandedStacks, setExpandedStacks = useState({})

	useEffect(function()
		local activeBackpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5) or player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		if not activeBackpack then
			warn("[SellGui] Backpack tidak ditemukan!")
			return
		end

		if isStorybook then
			setCars({
				{ Name = "Ferrari SF23", Price = 50000, Variant = "Golden", Rarity = "Legendary", Amount = 1 },
				{ Name = "Mercedes AMG W14", Price = 45000, Variant = "Normal", Rarity = "Epic", Amount = 3 },
				{ Name = "McLaren MCL38", Price = 35000, Variant = "Galaxy", Rarity = "Mythic", Amount = 1 },
				{ Name = "Red Bull RB19", Price = 80000, Variant = "Carbon", Rarity = "God", Amount = 2 },
			})
			return
		end

		local function updateCars()
			local backpackCars = {}
			local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

			-- 1. Pindai item di Backpack
			for _, tool in pairs(activeBackpack:GetChildren()) do
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					local isCar = CollectionService:HasTag(tool, "Car") or tool:GetAttribute("Price") ~= nil
					if isCar then
						table.insert(backpackCars, tool)
						print("[SellGui] Menemukan mobil di Backpack: " .. tool.Name .. " - Price: " .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("Price")))
					end
				end
			end

			-- 2. Pindai item di Karakter (Mobil yang sedang di-equip)
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				for _, tool in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
					if tool:IsA("Tool") then
						local isCar = CollectionService:HasTag(tool, "Car") or tool:GetAttribute("Price") ~= nil
						if isCar then
							if not table.find(backpackCars, tool) then
								table.insert(backpackCars, tool)
								print("[SellGui] Menemukan mobil di Karakter (Equipped): " .. tool.Name .. " - Price: " .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("Price")))
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			print("[SellGui] Total mobil berhasil dimuat ke UI: " .. tostring(#backpackCars))
			setCars(backpackCars)
		end

		-- Pindai awal
		updateCars()

		-- Hubungkan listener perubahan backpack
		local connection = activeBackpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.3, updateCars)
		end)

		local removeConnection = activeBackpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.1, updateCars)
		end)

		-- Hubungkan listener ketika karakter berpindah/meng-equip sesuatu
		local charAddedConn
		local charChildAddedConn
		local charChildRemovedConn

		local function setupCharacterListeners(character)
			if charChildAddedConn then charChildAddedConn:Disconnect() end
			if charChildRemovedConn then charChildRemovedConn:Disconnect() end

			charChildAddedConn = character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					task.delay(0.1, updateCars)
				end
			end)
			charChildRemovedConn = character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					task.delay(0.1, updateCars)
				end
			end)
		end

		if player.Character then
			setupCharacterListeners(player.Character)
		end

		charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			setupCharacterListeners(character)
			task.delay(0.5, updateCars)
		end)

		return function()
			connection:Disconnect()
			removeConnection:Disconnect()
			if charAddedConn then charAddedConn:Disconnect() end
			if charChildAddedConn then charChildAddedConn:Disconnect() end
			if charChildRemovedConn then charChildRemovedConn:Disconnect() end
		end
	end, {})

	useEffect(function()
		task.defer(function()
			for i, car in ipairs(cars) do
				local carItem = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SellGui")
					and playerGui.SellGui:FindFirstChild("CarView_" .. i, true)
				if carItem and typeof(car) == "Instance" then
					ViewportManager.setupViewport(viewportCache, carItem, car, { bgTransparency = 0.95 })
				elseif carItem and not isStorybook then
					print("[SellGui] Warning: CarView_" .. i .. " not found for " .. car.Name)
				end
			end
		end)

		return function()
			for _, car in ipairs(cars) do
				if typeof(car) == "Instance" then
					ViewportManager.clearCache(viewportCache, car)
				end
			end
		end
	end, { cars })

	-- Build children for ListContainer
	local function buildListChildren()
		local children = {
			UIListLayout = e("UIListLayout", {
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 10),
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}),

			UIPadding = e("UIPadding", {
				PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8),
				PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8),
				PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8),
				PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8),
			}),
		}

		if #cars > 0 then
			for i, car in ipairs(cars) do
				children["CarItem_" .. i] = e(CarItem, {
					car = car,
					layoutOrder = i,
					isStorybook = isStorybook,
					isExpanded = expandedStacks[car] or false,
					onToggleExpand = function()
						local newExpanded = table.clone(expandedStacks)
						newExpanded[car] = not (expandedStacks[car] or false)
						setExpandedStacks(newExpanded)
					end,
					onSell = function(selectedCar, stackChildName)
						if props.onSellCar then
							props.onSellCar(selectedCar, stackChildName)
						end
					end,
				})
			end
		else
			children["EmptyState"] = e("TextLabel", {
				Text = "No cars to sell 🚗",
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
				TextScaled = true,
				Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			})
		end

		return children
	end

	-- Responsive styling: Scale on mobile, locked max size on PC/Tablet
	local MainFrame = e("Frame", {
		Size = isStorybook and UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.8, 0),
		Position = not isStorybook and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) or nil,
		AnchorPoint = not isStorybook and Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) or nil,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
		BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 75),
		BorderSizePixel = 1,
	}, {
		UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),

		-- Max / Min constraint for responsiveness across device types
		UISizeConstraint = not isStorybook and e("UISizeConstraint", {
			MinSize = Vector2.new(320, 420),
			MaxSize = Vector2.new(520, 680),
		}) or nil,

		-- Header Section
		Header = e("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 55),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
			BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60),
			BorderSizePixel = 1,
			LayoutOrder = 1,
		}, {
			UICorner = e("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
			
			-- Cover top corners of corner frame to look clean
			CornerBlocker = e("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -10),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}),

			Title = e("TextLabel", {
				Text = "🏎️ GARAGE SALE",
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

function SellGuiManager:sellCar(player, car, stackChildName)
	if not player or not player.Parent then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Player tidak ditemukan",
		}
	end

	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not char or not root then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Character tidak ditemukan",
		}
	end

	-- ===== ANTI-CHEAT: Verifikasi lokasi =====
	local plotName = player:GetAttribute("MyPlotName")
	if not plotName or plotName == "" then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Plot tidak ditemukan",
		}
	end

	local myPlot = workspace.Plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
	if not myPlot then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Plot tidak valid",
		}
	end

	local sellArea = myPlot:FindFirstChild("SellArea") and myPlot.SellArea:FindFirstChild("Area")
	if not sellArea then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Sell area tidak ditemukan",
		}
	end

	-- Hitung jarak asli di server
	local jarak = (root.Position - sellArea:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
	if jarak > MAX_DISTANCE then
		warn("[ANTI-CHEAT] " .. player.Name .. " mencoba jual mobil dari luar area! Jarak: " .. jarak)
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Anda terlalu jauh dari sell area! (" .. math.floor(jarak) .. "m)",
		}
	end

	-- ===== VALIDASI MOBIL =====
	local inBackpack = car and car:IsDescendantOf(player) or false
	local inCharacter = car and player.Character and car:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) or false
	
	print("[SellGuiServer] sellCar -> Player:", player.Name, "| Car:", tostring(car), "| Parent:", car and tostring(car.Parent) or "nil", "| inBackpack:", inBackpack, "| inCharacter:", inCharacter, "| Stack:", tostring(stackChildName))

	if not car or (not inBackpack and not inCharacter) then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Mobil tidak valid atau tidak milik Anda",
		}
	end

	-- ===== PROSES HARGA BERDASARKAN TUMPUKAN (STACK) =====
	local harga = 0
	local nama = car:GetAttribute("Name") or car.Name
	local amount = car:GetAttribute("Amount") or 1
	local stacksFolder = car:FindFirstChild("Stacks")

	if stackChildName and stackChildName ~= "" and amount > 1 then
		if stackChildName == "Base" then
			-- Jual mobil basis utama, promosikan stack berikutnya menjadi basis baru
			harga = car:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
			if stacksFolder then
				local allStacks = stacksFolder:GetChildren()
				if #allStacks > 0 then
					local nextConfig = allStacks[1]
					-- Salin atribut dari stack cadangan ke Tool utama
					for attrName, value in pairs(nextConfig:GetAttributes()) do
						car:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
					end
					nextConfig:Destroy()
				end
			end
			car:SetAttribute("Amount", amount - 1)
		else
			-- Jual salah satu mobil di dalam folder Stacks
			if stacksFolder then
				local configNode = stacksFolder:FindFirstChild(stackChildName)
				if configNode then
					harga = configNode:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
					configNode:Destroy()
					car:SetAttribute("Amount", amount - 1)
				else
					return {
						Success = false,
						Error = "Data tumpukan mobil tidak ditemukan",
					}
				end
			else
				return {
					Success = false,
					Error = "Folder tumpukan tidak ditemukan",
				}
			end
		end
	else
		-- Jual mobil tunggal (normal)
		harga = car:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
		car:Destroy()
	end

	-- Validasi harga hasil akhir
	if harga <= 0 or harga > 999999999 then
		warn("[ANTI-CHEAT] " .. player.Name .. " mencoba jual dengan harga invalid: " .. harga)
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Harga mobil tidak valid",
		}
	end

	-- ===== EKSEKUSI TRANSAKSI =====
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats or not leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash") then
		return {
			Success = false,
			Error = "Leaderstats tidak ditemukan",
		}
	end

	-- Tambah uang
	leaderstats.Cash.Value = leaderstats.Cash.Value + harga

	print("[SellGui] " .. player.Name .. " cuan $" .. harga .. " dari " .. nama .. (stackChildName and " (Stack)" or ""))

	return {
		Success = true,
		Message = "Berhasil menjual " .. nama .. " seharga $" .. harga,
	}
end

	}

I've been working on refining the selling GUI. The user experience is crucial here. I'm focusing on ensuring the sell GUI doesn't automatically close after a sale, unless explicitly triggered by the player. This is to avoid unnecessary character repositioning and improve the flow.


**Investigating The GUI Closure**

I've got it! The sell GUI's automatic closure isn't directly tied to the tool's destruction, as I initially suspected. It's due to the proximity detection loop in `SellGui.client.luau`. Specifically, when a player moves outside the `SELL_RADIUS` (8 studs from the sell area), the UI closes. I need to make sure the UI stays open after a sale, and only closes if the player moves away or explicitly closes it. I am planning to remove this proximity check.


**Clarifying The UI Behavior**

I'm now zeroing in on the UI closing behavior after a sale. I realize the issue stems from the player needing to be *near* the sell area to keep the UI open, and I believe that this 'proximity check' is the issue. If the `SELL_RADIUS` is indeed very small, this forces repeated character movement. I'm considering if the user desires the UI to only close on a manual "X" click, or if it should auto-close at all. Ultimately, it seems they want the UI to *stay open* unless closed manually.


**Revisiting Anti-Cheat Concerns**

I've just realized a critical server-side check. While I improved the UI to stay open, the server's anti-cheat still checks the distance. Specifically, line 60 in `SellGuiServer.server.luau` uses a `MAX_DISTANCE` of 8 studs. If I allow the UI to persist when the player walks away, selling won't work because the server will block it. I now have to consider whether to increase the server-side `MAX_DISTANCE`, or remove that check altogether. It seems the user wants the ability to sell from anywhere after opening the UI.


**Calculating Maximum Distance**

I've been calculating the maximum distance allowed for selling. Initially, I was thinking about `200` studs. I considered checking if the player is within their plot using an attribute. But then I realized that the client UI opens only at the `SellArea`. So, as long as the player is within 150 studs of the `SellArea`, the server should permit the sale. Thus, I'll update the server script and set `MAX_DISTANCE` to `150` (or `200`) to cover the entire plot and ensure a safe, localized selling range. I think this will do the trick!


**Implementing The Client Logic**

I'm now implementing the client-side changes for the sell GUI. I'm adding a close button to the UI to give the user manual control over closing the UI, and will update the client script to match. The key is in `SellGui.client.luau`. I'll open the UI when the player enters the sell area, and it will stay open until explicitly closed. The core logic involves a loop to open the UI when the player is near and the UI is not open. If the player walks away, the UI will not automatically close; instead, they manually close it by clicking "X". The proximity check now manages when the UI opens initially. My `onClose` callback will set `currentComponent` to `nil`.


**Refining The Proximity Logic**

I'm now refining the proximity logic within the client script. I'm introducing `wasInsideArea` to accurately manage the UI's open/close state. The UI now only opens when the player transitions from *outside* to *inside* the sell area. If they close the UI while inside, it won't reopen immediately, preventing unwanted UI pops. This involves a clear state transition: if `isNear` is true and `wasInsideArea` was false, and the UI isn't already open, it opens the UI. The core concept is in the `SellGui.client.luau` script.

**Analyzing the UI Rendering**

I've realized a critical flaw in the UI rendering logic. Using `root:render` within `showToast` overwrites the entire existing render tree. This means that if the `SellGui` UI is open, the toast list would completely replace it, effectively closing the UI. This isn't the intended behavior!


**Unifying the UI Render**

I've crafted a unified render helper, `updateUIRender()`, to prevent the UI from disappearing. This function conditionally renders both `SellGui` and `ToastContainer` within the root, ensuring the toast list doesn't overwrite the main UI. If the UI is open, `SellGui` is rendered along with the toast list, otherwise, only the toast list is rendered. This resolves the critical issue where the UI would close on car sales, by including a unified render system, that ensures the main `SellGui` UI component, is kept inside the render tree!


**Refining the Toast Logic**

My latest revision of `showToast` is now completely clean! I've removed the internal state from `ToastComponent`. Instead, the toast now uses a timer that removes the toast from the list using `task.delay`. After the specified duration, the toast is removed, and then a re-render is triggered, ensuring it disappears. I've eliminated the previous inconsistencies that relied on the next render.

local function handleSellCar(car, stackChildName)
	if not car then
		return
	end

	local carName = nil
	if type(car) == "userdata" and car:IsA("Tool") then
		carName = car:GetAttribute("Name") or car.Name
	else
		carName = car.Name or "Unknown"
	end

	print("[SellGui CLIENT] Selling car: " .. tostring(carName) .. (stackChildName and (" (" .. stackChildName .. ")") or ""))

	local result = networker:fetch("sellCar", car, stackChildName)

	if result and result.Success then

		showToast("✅ " .. result.Message, true, 2.5)
	else
		local errorMsg = result and result.Error or "Unknown error"
		warn("[SellGui CLIENT] ❌ " .. errorMsg)
		showToast("❌ " .. errorMsg, false, 3)
	end
end

	if not cars or #cars == 0 then
		print("[SellGui CLIENT] No cars to sell")
		showToast("❌ Tidak ada mobil untuk dijual", false, 2)
		return
	end

-- ===============================================
-- GAME UTILITIES - Shared client/server functions
-- ===============================================

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local GameUtils = {}

-- ===== NUMBER/CURRENCY FORMATTING =====

-- 1. Format price/money with commas (e.g., 30000 -> 30,000)
function GameUtils.formatPrice(price: number | string): string
	local str = tostring(price)
	return str:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

-- 2. Format money compactly (e.g., 1200 -> 1,2K; 1500000 -> 1,5M)
function GameUtils.formatCompact(value: number): string
	local textMoney = tostring(value)
	local word = ""

	if value >= 1e12 then
		textMoney = string.format("%.1f", value / 1e12)
		word = "T"
	elseif value >= 1e9 then
		textMoney = string.format("%.1f", value / 1e9)
		word = "B"
	elseif value >= 1e6 then
		textMoney = string.format("%.1f", value / 1e6)
		word = "M"
	elseif value >= 1e3 then
		textMoney = string.format("%.1f", value / 1e3)
		word = "K"
	end

	-- Remove decimal if it is .0
	textMoney = textMoney:gsub("%.0$", "")
	-- Format decimal dot to comma
	textMoney = textMoney:gsub("%.", ",")

	return textMoney .. word
end

-- ===== PLOT AND AREA DETECTION =====

-- 3. Get player's plot folder
function GameUtils.getPlayerPlot(player: Player): Folder?
	if not player then return nil end
	local plotName = player:GetAttribute("MyPlotName")
	if not plotName or plotName == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return workspace.Plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
end

-- 4. Get plot's sell area
function GameUtils.getPlotSellArea(plot: Folder): Part?
	if not plot then return nil end
	local sellAreaFolder = plot:FindFirstChild("SellArea")
	if not sellAreaFolder then
		return nil
	end
	return sellAreaFolder:FindFirstChild("Area")
end

-- 5. Get player's sell area (convenient helper combining 3 & 4)
function GameUtils.getPlayerSellArea(player: Player): Part?
	local plot = GameUtils.getPlayerPlot(player)
	if not plot then
		return nil
	end
	return GameUtils.getPlotSellArea(plot)
end

-- ===== TOOL AND VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION =====

-- 6. Check if a tool is classified as a car
function GameUtils.isCar(tool: Instance): boolean
	if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return false
	end
	return CollectionService:HasTag(tool, "Car") or tool:GetAttribute("Price") ~= nil
end

-- 7. Scan and retrieve all car tools owned by a player (backpack + equipped)
function GameUtils.getPlayerCars(player: Player): {Tool}
	local cars = {}
	if not player then return cars end

	-- Scan Backpack
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if GameUtils.isCar(tool) then
				table.insert(cars, tool)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Scan Character (Equipped tools)
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		for _, tool in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if GameUtils.isCar(tool) then
				if not table.find(cars, tool) then
					table.insert(cars, tool)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return cars
end

return GameUtils

	if plot then

		if spawnLocation then
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				character:PivotTo(spawnLocation.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0))

			if character then
				character:PivotTo(centerArea.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 10))

	end
end)

function GameConfig.CalculatePrice(base, rName, vNameString)
	local rData = GameConfig.Rarities[rName] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
	local totalVariantMulti = 1.0

	if vNameString and vNameString ~= "" then
		local activeVariants = string.split(vNameString, ",")
		for _, vName in pairs(activeVariants) do
			local vData = GameConfig.Variants[vName]
			if vData then
				totalVariantMulti = totalVariantMulti + (vData.Multiplier - 1.0)
			end
		end
	end

	return math.floor((base or 1000) * rData.PriceMod * totalVariantMulti)
end
args.TargetContent:
function GameConfig.CalculatePrice(base, rName, vNameString)
	local rData = GameConfig.Rarities[rName] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
	local totalVariantMulti = 1.0

	if vNameString and vNameString ~= "" then
		local activeVariants = string.split(vNameString, ",")
		for _, vName in pairs(activeVariants) do
			local vData = GameConfig.Variants[vName]
			if vData then
				totalVariantMulti = totalVariantMulti * vData.Multiplier
			end
		end
	end

	return math.floor((base or 1000) * rData.PriceMod * totalVariantMulti)
end

I have found and fixed the bug that prevented the module from printing:

### **Why it was happening:**
In `getMachineComponents` (inside `SpawnerBoxManager.luau`), the code tried to find the `billboardGui` child with this line:
```luau
billboardGui = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
    or child:FindFirstChild(string.find(child.Name, "Billboard"), true)
```
1. `string.find(child.Name, "Billboard")` returns a **number** (e.g. `9` for `"AtlantisBillboard"`), not a string.
2. This meant it evaluated to `child:FindFirstChild(9, true)`. 
3. Because it was looking for a child named `"9"` (which obviously doesn't exist), it returned `nil`, causing the entire `if billboardGui then` block to be skipped.

### **The Fix:**
I rewritten the logic to look for the **`Area`** or **`ModuleScript`** directly inside the child first. If those elements exist, it correctly identifies the model as the `billboardGui`. Otherwise, it falls back to checking for sub-models or uses itself.

This fully resolves the issue, and the module and upgrades UI items will now print and load properly!

58: 			handle.Massless = true

63: 		box:SetAttribute("Amount", 1)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local GameUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameUtils"))

-- 1. WAIT FOR PLOT AND MACHINES FOLDER
local plot = GameUtils.getPlayerPlot(player)
if not plot then
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MyPlotName"):Wait()
	plot = GameUtils.getPlayerPlot(player)
	while not plot do
		task.wait(0.5)
		plot = GameUtils.getPlayerPlot(player)
	end
end

local machines = plot:WaitForChild("Machines", 15) :: Folder?
if not machines then
	warn("[UpgradeClient] Folder Machines tidak ditemukan di plot!")
	return
end

local BuyUpgradeFunction = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyUpgradeFunction") :: RemoteFunction

local function getBillboard(machineArea: Folder): Model?
	for _, child in ipairs(machineArea:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Model") and string.find(child.Name, "Billboard") then
			return child
		end
	end
	return machineArea:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
end

local function setupMachineArea(machineArea: Folder)
	if not machineArea:IsA("Folder") then return end

	local billboard = getBillboard(machineArea)
	if not billboard then
		billboard = machineArea:WaitForChild("Billboard", 5) or machineArea:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
	end

	if billboard then
		local moduleScript = billboard:WaitForChild("ModuleScript", 5) or billboard:FindFirstChildOfClass("ModuleScript")
		if moduleScript then
			local module = require(moduleScript)
			local area = billboard:WaitForChild("Area", 5)
			if area then
				local surface = area:WaitForChild("SurfaceGui", 5)
				if surface then
					local list = surface:WaitForChild("List", 5)
					if list then
						local function setupButtons()
							for _, item in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
								if item:IsA("Frame") then
									local button = item:WaitForChild("Button", 5) :: TextButton?
									if button and not button:GetAttribute("Connected") then
										button:SetAttribute("Connected", true)
										button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
											print("[UpgradeClient] Mencoba membeli upgrade: " .. item.Name .. " untuk " .. machineArea.Name)
											local success, msg = BuyUpgradeFunction:InvokeServer(machineArea, item.Name)
											if success then
												print("[UpgradeClient] ✅ Upgrade sukses: " .. item.Name)
											else
												warn("[UpgradeClient] ❌ Upgrade gagal: " .. tostring(msg))
											end
										end)
									end
								end
							end
						end

						-- Initial setup
						setupButtons()

						-- In case items are added dynamically later
						list.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
							if child:IsA("Frame") then
								task.defer(setupButtons)
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Setup existing machines
for _, machineArea in ipairs(machines:GetChildren()) do
	if machineArea:IsA("Folder") then
		task.spawn(setupMachineArea, machineArea)
	end
end

-- Handle dynamically added machines
machines.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child:IsA("Folder") then
		task.spawn(setupMachineArea, child)
	end
end)

function SpawnerBoxManager.Init()
	-- Initialize existing machines
	for _, machineArea in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(SPAWNER_TAG)) do
		task.spawn(setupMachineArea, machineArea)
	end

	-- Initialize new machines added later (bought from tycoon)
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(SPAWNER_TAG):Connect(setupMachineArea)

	-- Handle BuyUpgrade RemoteFunction
	local BuyUpgradeFunction = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyUpgradeFunction")
	if BuyUpgradeFunction and BuyUpgradeFunction:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
		BuyUpgradeFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player, machineArea, upgradeName)
			if not player or not machineArea or not upgradeName then
				return false, "Parameter tidak lengkap"
			end

			-- 1. Validasi kepemilikan plot
			local machinesFolder = machineArea.Parent
			local plotModel = machinesFolder and machinesFolder.Parent
			local owner = plotModel and plotModel:GetAttribute("Owner")
			if owner ~= player.Name then
				return false, "Anda bukan pemilik plot ini!"
			end

			-- 2. Cari billboard dan modul upgrade
			local machinePart, billboardGui = getMachineComponents(machineArea)
			if not billboardGui then
				return false, "Billboard mesin tidak ditemukan"
			end

			local moduleScript = billboardGui:FindFirstChild("ModuleScript") or billboardGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("ModuleScript")
			if not moduleScript then
				return false, "Modul upgrade tidak ditemukan"
			end

			local module = require(moduleScript)
			local upgradeItem = nil
			for _, v in ipairs(module.upgradeList) do
				if v.ID == upgradeName then
					upgradeItem = v
					break
				end
			end

			if not upgradeItem then
				return false, "Upgrade tidak valid untuk mesin ini"
			end

			-- 3. Cek apakah sudah dibeli sebelumnya
			if machineArea:GetAttribute(upgradeName) then
				return false, "Upgrade ini sudah dibeli!"
			end

			-- 4. Validasi Cash
			local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local cash = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
			if not cash then
				return false, "Data uang tidak ditemukan"
			end

			local cost = upgradeItem.BasePrice or 0
			if cash.Value < cost then
				return false, "Uang Anda tidak cukup!"
			end

			-- 5. Eksekusi Pembelian
			cash.Value = cash.Value - cost
			machineArea:SetAttribute(upgradeName, true)

			-- 6. Hapus UI upgrade di billboard dari server agar sinkron untuk semua player
			local billArea = billboardGui:FindFirstChild("Area")
			local surface = billArea and billArea:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
			local list = surface and surface:FindFirstChild("List")
			local itemUI = list and list:FindFirstChild(upgradeName)
			if itemUI then
				itemUI:Destroy()
			end

			print("[SpawnerBoxManager] " .. player.Name .. " membeli upgrade " .. upgradeName .. " seharga $" .. cost)
			return true, "Upgrade berhasil!"
		end
	end
end

---

### **Problems Identified in the Original Script:**
1. **Immediate Crash on Spawn**: The script attempted to access the player's plot (`GameUtils.getPlayerPlot(player)`) immediately upon script execution. If the plot hadn't been claimed yet, it returned `nil`, causing the script to crash immediately on line 8.
2. **Replication Issues**: The client attempted to set attributes directly on the `machineArea` (`machineArea:SetAttribute(item.Name, ...)`) and deduct cash. Because of Roblox's **FilteringEnabled**, client-side attribute changes do not replicate to the server. The upgrades were purely client-side visual modifications.
3. **Incorrect Cash Path**: The client read/wrote cash via `player:GetAttribute("Cash")`, whereas the game's actual currency is stored on the server under `player.leaderstats.Cash.Value`.
4. **No Dynamic Loading**: The script only iterated `machines:GetChildren()` once on start. If the player bought new machines from the tycoon during gameplay, they would never get click listeners connected.

---

### **What I Have Implemented:**

1. **Robust Client Initialization ([UpgradeMachineArea.client.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UpgradeMachineArea.client.luau))**:
   - Added a safe waiting mechanism: it listens to `"MyPlotName"` attribute changes and yields until the plot is fully claimed and loaded.
   - Added standard replication yields (`WaitForChild`) on folders like `Machines`, `Billboard`, `ModuleScript`, and `SurfaceGui`.
   - Setup a listener for `machines.ChildAdded` so that whenever the player buys a new machine spawner from the tycoon, it is automatically set up with the appropriate upgrade listeners in real-time.
   - Connected buttons to invoke the **`BuyUpgradeFunction`** RemoteFunction instead of trying to modify values locally.

2. **Secure Server-side Upgrade Handler ([SpawnerBoxManager.luau](file:///C:/Project/Roblox%20Studio%20Projects/Projects/F1-Tycoon/src/ServerScriptService/SpawnerBoxManager/SpawnerBoxManager.luau))**:
   - Connected **`BuyUpgradeFunction.OnServerInvoke`** inside the `Init()` function.
   - **Verification**: Checks that the player owns the plot model the machine belongs to.
   - **Cost Validation**: Fetches the price directly from the machine's configuration module and ensures `player.leaderstats.Cash.Value >= BasePrice`.
   - **Execution**: Deducts the player's cash on the server, updates the attribute on the server (which automatically triggers the machine's speed/experience/rarity multiplier recalculations), and destroys the upgrade button UI from the `BillboardGui` on the server so it disappears for all players on the server.

# Riwayat Perubahan Proyek F1-Tycoon

Dokumen ini mencatat seluruh riwayat pemeriksaan, perbaikan, dan optimasi yang telah diimplementasikan pada proyek F1-Tycoon.

---

## 1. Modul Utilitas Bersama (GameUtils)
Untuk menghindari duplikasi fungsi dan menjaga prinsip DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), dibuatlah modul baru di `ReplicatedStorage`:
*   **File Baru**: `src/ReplicatedStorage/GameUtils.luau`
*   **Fungsi yang Disatukan**:
    *   `formatPrice(price)`: Memformat harga dengan koma (misal: `30,000`).
    *   `formatCompact(value)`: Memformat angka secara ringkas untuk tampilan stats (misal: `1K`, `1,2M`, `5B`).
    *   `getPlayerPlot(player)`: Mencari folder Plot milik player secara aman menggunakan atribut `MyPlotName`.
    *   `getPlotSellArea(plot)` / `getPlayerSellArea(player)`: Mengembalikan objek area penjualan fisik pada plot pemain.
    *   `isCar(tool)`: Memvalidasi apakah suatu objek `Tool` adalah mobil (menggunakan Tag/Attribute).
    *   `getPlayerCars(player)`: Memindai seluruh mobil milik pemain, baik yang ada di dalam `Backpack` maupun sedang di-equip di dalam `Character`.

---

## 2. Optimasi & Peningkatan Sell GUI
*   **Keamanan & Jarak Jual**:
    *   Batas jarak jual (`MAX_DISTANCE`) di server (`SellGuiServer.server.luau`) ditingkatkan menjadi `200` stud agar pemain dapat menjual dari area mana saja di plot mereka.
    *   Proximity detection di client (`SellGui.client.luau`) diubah agar **hanya membuka UI** ketika pemain pertama kali memasuki area penjualan.
    *   UI **tidak akan menutup secara otomatis** saat pemain menjauh atau saat transaksi sukses. UI hanya akan menutup jika tombol manual **"X"** diklik.
*   **Responsivitas UI & Stack Grouping**:
    *   Mengatur ukuran UI agar responsif menggunakan persentase skala relatif (`0.9, 0.8`) dan membatasi ukuran maksimal/minimal menggunakan `UISizeConstraint` agar pas di Mobile, Tablet, maupun PC.
    *   Menambahkan tombol tutup manual **"X"** di header UI.
    *   Jika pemain memiliki mobil dengan tipe yang sama (`Amount > 1`), tombol **SELL** akan disembunyikan dan diganti dengan tombol **VIEW STACK**. Ketika diklik, list mobil yang sama akan terbuka ke bawah (*expandable sub-list*) dengan tombol **SELL** masing-masing. Jika sisa mobil tinggal 1, list akan kembali menampilkan tombol **SELL** utama secara otomatis.
    *   Mengoptimalkan loop render React dengan menambahkan dependency array `{ cars }` pada `useEffect` untuk mencegah lag infinite re-render loop.

---

## 3. Penyesuaian Formula Harga & Tampilan Kartu
*   **Tampilan Detail Kartu**:
    *   Mengubah susunan info di header kartu mobil: **Nama Mobil** -> **Variant Text (Berwarna)** -> **Rarity Badge** -> **Harga**.
    *   Mengaktifkan `RichText` pada label Variant dengan mengambil format warna dari `GameConfig.GetColoredVariantList` agar nama variant (seperti `[Shiny]`, `[Golden]`, dll.) tampil dengan warna tema masing-masing.
*   **Formula Multiplier Variant (GameConfig)**:
    *   Mengubah kalkulasi harga gabungan variant di `GameConfig.CalculatePrice` menjadi **Aditif** (ditambahkan) daripada **Multiplikatif** (dikalikan). Hal ini mencegah harga mobil dengan banyak variant naik secara ekstrem hingga triliunan rupiah (misal dari `6.750.000.000.000` menjadi harga yang lebih masuk akal dan seimbang).

---

## 4. Perbaikan Kamera Viewport (ViewportManager)
*   Meningkatkan presisi rendering 3D pada slot Hotbar dan Sell GUI list:
    *   **Box / Kotak**: Diatur dengan `FieldOfView = 45` dan jarak kamera `1.6x` lebih jauh agar seluruh bodi kotak muat sempurna dalam frame tanpa terpotong.
    *   **Car / Mobil**: Diatur dengan `FieldOfView = 30` dan jarak kamera `0.95x` lebih dekat agar detail mobil terlihat jelas dan tidak terlalu kekecilan.

---

## 5. Perbaikan Bug Spawner & Sistem Upgrade Mesin
*   **Perbaikan Bug Billboard (SpawnerBoxManager)**:
    *   Memperbaiki bug pencarian `billboardGui` di server yang menggunakan fungsi salah `FindFirstChild(number)` akibat `string.find`. Sekarang server mendeteksi objek billboard secara akurat dengan memeriksa keberadaan `Area` atau `ModuleScript` secara langsung.
*   **Sistem Upgrade Mesin (UpgradeMachineArea)**:
    *   **UpgradeMachineArea.client.luau**: Mengatasi error crash saat player spawn dengan mendeteksi plot secara dinamis. Mendengarkan event `ChildAdded` pada folder `Machines` agar mesin baru yang dibeli dari tycoon langsung mendapatkan listener tombol upgrade.
    *   **Sinkronisasi Remote (BuyUpgradeFunction)**: Mengubah pemrosesan upgrade yang sebelumnya dilakukan secara ilegal di client menjadi panggilan aman ke server melalui RemoteFunction `BuyUpgradeFunction`. Server akan memotong uang (`player.leaderstats.Cash`), menyimpan level upgrade ke attribute mesin, dan menghapus kartu upgrade di Billboard secara tersinkronisasi untuk semua pemain.
